# ViraStack AI

> Architecture rules for AI coding agents in modern React projects. One command installs the same rules in Claude Code and Cursor native formats, plus an AGENTS.md map for every other agent. npm: `@virastack/ai` (v2).

Install: `npx @virastack/ai init`. Detects Next.js vs TanStack Start from `package.json` and writes only the relevant rules.

For the CLI, installed files and rule list inline, prefer [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/ai/llms-full.txt).

## Docs & pages

- [AI overview](https://virastack.com/ai): Product landing (how it works, installed rules, CLI)

- [GitHub](https://github.com/virastack/ai): Source and rule templates

## What it writes

- `.claude/rules/virastack/*.md`: Claude Code rules (`--agent claude`)
- `.cursor/rules/virastack/*.mdc`: Cursor rules (`--agent cursor`)
- `.agents/rules/virastack/*.md`: plain Markdown rules for any agent (`--agent none`)
- `AGENTS.md`: managed `virastack-ai` block with persona, commands and rule map
- `CLAUDE.md`: gets an `@AGENTS.md` import line if missing
- `.virastack/ai.json`: manifest of installed files with hashes
